A '''feen''' was a sweet-tasting [[Fruit/Legends|fruit]] found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. Over time, it also became a common given name for [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]].
